### Added

- (agent-platform) [Keep the reading position while a reply arrives and offer Jump to bottom](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3389) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — On a session's page, a reply coming in no longer scrolls away the text you are reading. When something new arrives below the view, `Jump to bottom` above the message box takes you there; a message you send moves to the top.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Gate organizations behind an opt-in flag](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3393) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — Organizations, added in v3.32.0, is hidden unless the deployment turns it on with `agentPlatform.organizations.enabled` or, where that is unset, a person opts in with the `agent-platform-organizations` feature flag. It also needs an installation that supports organizations.
- (app) [Move organizations into the profile menu](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3395) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson) — Organizations moves from the rail into the `Profile and settings` menu, on desktop and phone; the opt-in from [#3393](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3393) still applies.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.33.0...v3.34.0
